text:
Event: Kelbury summit at Yordale Hall. Host: Galen Morcroft. Attendees: 20. Catering: Plated dinner.

Staffing: Wren out; Pia covering. Mira out; Esme covering. Jonah out; Bram covering.

Room Notes:
- Library annex: Lift slow. Too cold all day/evening. Coffee working. Keep clear for Dell’s visitors. Umbrella left.
- Loading bay: Lift slow. Repainting (noise evening). Too cold afternoon/morning. Coffee working. Keep clear for Finn and Suri’s visitors. Free morning. Umbrella left. Morning stand-up moved to North office.
- North office: Too cold morning/afternoon/evening. Coffee working. Lift slow. Repainting (noise afternoon). Umbrella left. Keep clear for Opal and Ada’s visitors. Morning stand-up moved here.
- Garden studio: Repainting (noise morning). Coffee working. Keep clear for Pia, Esme’s, Ines’s, and Wren’s visitors. Too cold evening. Lift slow. Afternoon stand-up moved here.
- Print room: Umbrella left. Free morning. Repainting (noise afternoon). Coffee working. Lift slow. Keep clear for Nils’s visitors. Cora prefers for reviews.
- Harbour room: Coffee working. Keep clear for Cora/Una’s visitors. Repainting (noise morning). Umbrella left. Lift slow today. Evening stand-up moved here. Rafe notes: too cold afternoon. Free in afternoon.
- East wing: Too cold all day. Repainting (noise evening). Keep clear for Teo’s, Hugo’s, and Opal’s visitors. Lift slow. Umbrella left. Coffee working.

Other: Hugo wants east wing kept clear for visitors. Need to send Leon morning meeting notes. Pending tasks unchanged. Check with Una before morning meeting. Vik involved. Ada and Finn swapping desks.
